children: USD.AI plans a CHIP supply unlock in July 2027 that will release at least 147.12 million tokens to investors and team members. The announced unlock amount is equal to 7.36% of CHIP's circulating supply.
The release is part of CHIP's monthly vesting schedule. Once the tokens are unlocked, the recipients will have a sizable new batch of CHIP available to sell.

title: USD.AI: At least 147.12 million CHIP unlock for investors and team - Jul 2027
